title: Frankish Tower
limitations: Represents the late standing tower documented in photographs around 1869. The supported dates cover a photographed appearance before dismantling.

The 8.69 by 7.78 m base and 25.90 m height follow the École française d’Athènes record. Reused stone blocks, crenellations, doors, timber stair and floor arrangement are reconstructed from photographs and the archive description.
The old tower abuts the south wing of the Propylaia. Its plinth uses standard Terrarium, with the base stepped into the coarse hill mesh. Surrounding features come from current map data.
